topic: Burnham and Highbridge fitness group raises £500 for Breast Cancer Now with pink fitness classes

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Burnham and Highbridge fitness group raises £500 for Breast Cancer Now with pink fitness classes

facts.label: Article
facts.value: A Burnham-On-Sea and Highbridge fitness group has raised nearly £500 for Breast Cancer Now after turning its classes pink for the charity’s Wear It Pink campaign. Fit & Fabulous Somerset teachers and class members joined in with the fundraising initiative, swapping their usual workout wear for a splash of pink to show their support for those affected by breast cancer. The special classes brought participants together to raise awareness of the disease and help fund vital research into breast cancer. Charlotte Simmons, owner of Fit and Fabulous Somerset, told Burnham-On-Sea.com: “Thank you to everyone who helped us raise awareness and funds for Breast Cancer Now. It was amazing to see so many of you join in the Wear It Pink campaign and support such a great cause. We have raised nearly £500 and the total keeps growing!” The Wear It Pink campaign gave Fit & Fabulous members the chance to combine their regular exercise sessions with a worthwhile cause, with participants showing their support through a colourful display of pink outfits. Breast Cancer Now supports people affected by breast cancer and funds research aimed at improving treatments and outcomes for those diagnosed with the disease. The fundraising total is continuing to grow, with Charlotte thanking everyone who took part and helped raise both awareness and money for the charity.

en.headline: Burnham and Highbridge fitness group raises £500 for Breast Cancer Now with pink fitness classes

facts.value: Precor erweitert die Glutebuilder-Linie um neue Selectorized Geräte für geführtes Glute-Training mit Steckgewichten. Geführte Bewegungsbahnen, verschiedene Einstellmöglichkeiten und eine kompakte Bauweise machen gezieltes Glute-Training für Mitglieder unterschiedlicher Leistungsniveaus zugänglich. Die Welt des Krafttrainings entwickelt sich kontinuierlich weiter. Neben Kraft, Stabilität und Verletzungsprävention gewinnen insbesondere Muskelaufbau und ästhetische Ziele an Bedeutung. Dabei ist gezieltes Glute-Training ein zentraler Trend. Um dieser Nachfrage gerecht zu werden, erweitert Precor seine Glutebuilder-Linie um neue Geräte mit Steckgewichten. Gemeinsam mit Glutebuilder entwickelt, verbinden sie die bewährte biomechanische Präzision und das leistungsorientierte Design der Plate-Loaded-Serie mit dem Komfort eines Steckgewichtsystems.
